# Burn Medications
Burn damage is heat, shock, cold and caustic: fire, electricity, freezing and acid. Treat the burns with ointment or a burn kit first (see [textlink="Wounds and Bleeding" link="CMUGuideMedicalWounds"]), then use these to heal the damage.
- [bold]Kelotane[/bold]: the standard burn medicine. Overdose at 30 units. - [bold]Dermaline[/bold]: heals burns faster than kelotane. Its overdose is lower, at 15 units. - [bold]Tricordrazine[/bold]: heals a little of everything, burns included.
Eschar, a full-thickness burn, doesn't heal with medicine. It has to be debrided surgically.
